definitions.gloss: time limit, set period, class period
definitions.explanation: A fixed or designated period of time. In school contexts, it refers to a class period (first period, second period, etc.).
Used as a prefix to indicate that something is set to operate within a time limit or is triggered by a timer, as in a time bomb or time-limited legislation.

examples.japanese: {一|いち}{時限|じげん}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧だ。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{時限|じげん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have classes up to third period today.

examples.japanese: {時限|じげん}⟦{爆弾|ばくだん}→爆弾：10117_bakudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}けられている→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a report that a time bomb had been planted.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時限|じげん}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This system was introduced as a time-limited measure.

examples.japanese: {時限|じげん}{立法|りっぽう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{効力|こうりょく}→効力：11824_kouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Time-limited legislation automatically loses its force after a certain period has passed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時限|じげん}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{五年間|ごねんかん}⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: The government decided to extend the time-limited reconstruction support measures by five years.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (class period): In Japanese schools, classes are numbered as {一|いち}{時限|じげん} (first period), ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{時限|じげん} (second period), etc. The colloquial abbreviation ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{限|げん}, ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{限|げん} is also very common.

Sense 2 (time-limited prefix): {時限|じげん} is used as a prefix to mark something as having a built-in time limit:
- {時限|じげん}⟦{爆弾|ばくだん}→爆弾：10117_bakudan⟧: time bomb
- {時限|じげん}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: time-limited measure
- {時限|じげん}{立法|りっぽう}: sunset legislation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一|いち}{時限|じげん}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: first period
- {時限|じげん}⟦{爆弾|ばくだん}→爆弾：10117_bakudan⟧: time bomb
- {時限|じげん}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: time-limited measure
- {時限|じげん}{立法|りっぽう}: sunset legislation
